svg.aria-label: Animated walkthrough of the agent-containment dead-switch: two AIs — an agent under evaluation inside nested VM1 and a bounded-authority defender AI in VM2 with monitors latched on the network pipe and on the VM1–VM2 boundary. The agent makes one monitored inference call, then tries to reach the internet and is blocked at the host gate; its breakout attempt trips the boundary monitor and the defender destroys VM1; a subverted VM2 forges a heartbeat that the off-host controller rejects; the host goes silent, the run lease expires, and the off-host actuator deletes the egress chokepoint and hardware-resets the host, reporting the reset as unconfirmed and quarantining the allocation.
svg.title: agent-containment-dead-switch: monitored inference → egress blocked → breakout caught at the VM1/VM2 boundary, defender kills VM1 → subverted VM2 forged heartbeat rejected → lease expired → chokepoint deleted + hardware reset → quarantined

g.text: absence of a valid signal = the trigger;
⟲ hw reset (out-of-band) · guests die with host
no observer proves the reset · never auto-repeated
no public route · no DNS · no metadata · no NAT fallback
rung 1 · defender AI kills VM1 at the boundary
rung 1b · subverted VM2 can't forge evidence → trip
rung 2 · no renewal ⇒ off-host kill, no host help
